meaning: DATA_AMP_BASE is the baseline ICP pulse amplitude taken as the median of per-beat :icp_amp over the pre-compression window from DATA_T0 up to 5 s before jugular compression onset. The same median defines fit.jl's stage-B target, so this one window choice sets both the plotted baseline and the number the fit is scored against.

could_move.what: Stage-B target value and hence the fitted parameters, since fit.jl recomputes the same median over the same window
Verification pass/fail margins that compare model amplitude to the baseline
Baseline line/annotation drawn in the data panels
Per-patient jugular-compression comparison decks built on m5 vs data
Derived contrasts, since plateau and post amplitudes use the same beat table and window convention

expectation: Unknown in size. The 5 s guard before onset and the median make the value robust to a few noisy beats, but if the pre-onset window is short or the recording drifts, the baseline can shift and drag the stage-B target with it. Direction cannot be inferred from the code alone.

check.why: Re-runs the verification for the fitted case and reprints the amplitude targets without redoing the fit, so a changed baseline shows up as a changed target and margin.
